copy: Not every love story needs a big life.
camera_psychology: extreme wide establishing shot; awe creates scale and negative space, making the couple feel tiny but chosen
visual: A twilight seaside or open-sky frame in warm ivory watercolor. The couple is small in the lower third, standing close but not posed. She has just noticed something in the sky; his posture is already angled toward her. The sky and sea are large, soft, and quiet, not dense or cinematic.
story_job: Stop the scroll with a public truth: the relationship does not need a grand life to feel meaningful.
must_show: couple small together in lower frame
his body subtly oriented toward her
clean upper-middle negative space for exact text
avoid: characters too tiny to read emotionally

copy: She points at the sky. He looks at her first.
camera_psychology: medium push-in with selective-attention reversal; the expected focal point is the sky, but his eye-line makes her the reward
visual: Camera moves closer from behind/three-quarter side. Her arm points upward, face lit with small excited wonder. He is beside her, but his eyes are on her expression instead of the sky. Their shoulders almost touch. The sky remains visible only as context.
story_job: Reveal the private meaning inside the public scene: the spectacle matters less than the person experiencing it.
must_show: his gaze clearly landing on her
no speech bubbles or extra labels
avoid: generic couple pose without eye-line story

camera_psychology: close-up attachment payoff; tactile cues and proximity replace spectacle, making the viewer feel emotional safety
visual: An intimate close-up or middle-close frame as they walk back from the water/sky moment. Their hands are close or lightly interlaced, one shared bag/scarf/phone detail visible, shoulders leaning toward each other. The big sky fades into warm paper behind them. The world has narrowed to the two of them.
story_job: Land the saveable thesis: home is the small shared attention, not the destination.
must_show: hands or shoulders as tactile proof
soft shared movement away from the big view
faces or profiles warm and recognizable
